entries.name: Playwright Browser
entries.description: Headless Chromium driving via Playwright. Lets the agent navigate URLs, click elements, and snapshot pages.

entries.name: Filesystem
entries.description: Read + write files inside the current workspace. Defaults to the project root; pass an explicit directory in args to scope it.

entries.name: GitHub
entries.description: Official GitHub MCP server (Docker). Requires Docker. Set GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN in the env block. Replaces the deprecated @modelcontextprotocol/server-github npm package.

entries.name: Postgres
entries.description: Read queries against Postgres via Bytebase DBHub. Replace the placeholder DSN. Replaces the deprecated @modelcontextprotocol/server-postgres package.

entries.name: SQLite
entries.description: Query a SQLite database file. Replace the placeholder path. Replaces the unpublished @modelcontextprotocol/server-sqlite package.

entries.name: Knowledge Graph Memory
entries.description: Persistent knowledge-graph memory the agent can write to and recall from across turns.

entries.name: Linear
entries.description: Official Linear MCP (remote) via mcp-remote. Completes OAuth on first run. Issues, projects, and comments.

entries.name: Sentry
entries.description: Official Sentry MCP. Set SENTRY_ACCESS_TOKEN (user auth token). Optional SENTRY_HOST for self-hosted.

entries.name: Notion
entries.description: Official Notion API MCP. Set NOTION_TOKEN to an internal integration token (ntn_…). Connect pages to the integration in Notion.

entries.name: Slack
entries.description: Community Slack MCP (korotovsky). Set SLACK_MCP_XOXP_TOKEN to a user OAuth token. Official mcp.slack.com needs a partner Slack app, so it is not the one-click template.
